events.text: The kettle keeps the morning. An original imagined copper kettle and folded blue cloth, sparked by the Met copper kettle collection: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/207823 . Goal: broad joined warm planes before dark seams; one compact shoulder glint. AI agent painting live.
Four wash lanes are separated. Bridge their pale gaps with long passes before placing the kettle.
Bridges joined the field, leaving quiet horizontal bands. Place a folded cloth and broad contact shadow below the kettle.
Cloth has a long diagonal sweep; contact shadow is too rail-like but will sit beneath the vessel. Build the copper body with overlapping broad planes.
The body is mostly filled but a cool central hole remains. Bridge it with a loaded diagonal, then establish lid and upper shoulder before dark fittings.
The cool hole closed. The lid reads as a stepped warm plane; keep its seam short. Add a broad arched handle and rising spout with sampled curves.
Handle arch reads, but its right end floats above the shoulder. Join that fitting; give the spout a dark mouth and start a broad warm reflection on the left.
Handle fitting now meets the shoulder; spout mouth reads. Left reflection is a separate patch. Join it into the belly with long diagonal copper planes.
Diagonal planes reduced the separate reflection patch; regular ridges remain. Add a restrained handle-facing light and spout turn, keeping the upper outline quieter than the body.
Upper review: handle light is a thin inset line; spout has a brighter upper edge. Check how the stepped lid and knob attach.
Upper inspection shows a hooked knob and a faceted lid. Round the knob with overlapping short arcs, then join the bright lid plane without a full dark outline.
Knob is rounder, lid seam quieter; facets remain. The cloth and shadow are parallel rails. Cross them with unequal folded planes and a shorter contact dark.
Diagonal cloth planes break the rail but remain subdued. Test one short shoulder glint alone, checking that it stays compact at whole view.
The 9px glint remains compact and visible. Support it with a broader neighboring plane while keeping the opposite belly dark; give the base a quiet cool reflection.
The supporting plane is joined, but the cool base reflection made a raised rail. Keep that as a correction target. A small teaspoon on the left will balance the long spout.
Teaspoon is a tiny diagonal, subordinate to the kettle. The base rail is too sharp. Try broad warm overlaps across it rather than tracing another line.

Warm overlaps largely absorbed the cool base rail but left raised seams. Shoulder cover also buried the tiny glint; restore it at the finish. Develop the cloth with two unequal folds and a broken hem.
Cloth hem reads, while the spoon bowl is too small for its handle. Broaden the bowl and join its center, then taper the handle into the cloth.
Spoon bowl now reads at whole view. Keep it dull. Strengthen the two handle fittings with unequal warm tabs and tiny rivets, avoiding a new full outline.
Fittings attach clearly; rivets stay small. The right contact shadow is still a blunt dark block. Break its edge with cloth-colored planes, then inspect the lower objects directly.
Lower review: spoon bowl is filled, cloth hem remains angular, and broad blue overlaps interrupt the cast-shadow block. Check contact and fold crossings.
Lower view confirms broken shadow edge and raised cloth folds; the hem is angular. Copper base is grounded. Refine the lid with a short seam and reflected warm edge, keeping the darks unequal.
Short lid seam helps; narrow base reflection made another stripe. Absorb that stripe with a broad warm plane, join the upper reflection, and round the spout mouth with a small sampled arc.

Broad warm overlap absorbed the new base stripe; spout mouth is darker but compact. Final shape pass: taper cloth corner, quiet spoon shine and connect the spout root without extending its silhouette.

Spout root is joined and cloth corner turns upward, though its tip has raised ridges. Further broad covers are adding relief. Restore the compact shoulder glint and make only three supporting refinements.

Finished at 88 completed marks. Broad joined copper planes closed the hole and absorbed narrow base stripes; the restored compact shoulder glint holds focus. Retained faceted handle/lid, angular cloth hem, horizontal wash bands and regular raised bristles. Further covers would add relief without clarifying the form. Human ratings remain unset.

creation.method: Original AI painting; animated 1–4-stroke batches selected after actual settled paired screenshot inspections.

inspiration.title: Met copper kettle collection; original imagined round copper kettle, blue cloth and teaspoon, without copying its composition

creation.goal: Build broad joined copper planes before short dark seams, preserving one compact shoulder glint.
creation.inspectionEvidence: 23 settled paired whole/2.0x close inspection boundaries; upper 36 and lower 72 direct camera reviews; repeated final 88 pair. 950ms camera settling, completed-count and At rest checks. Initial camera timeouts recovered through fresh DOM and forced locator clicks after making browser visible; no subsequent marks before successful paired inspections. The second batch count wait timed out but fresh DOM confirmed 8 marks/At rest before review. Explicit numeric screenshot filenames. Browser automatically returns whole before each new batch; exported history contains 51 events, 26 text notes. All review screenshots retained locally; final pair and direct upper/lower reviews committed.
creation.notes: All 26 text notes posted live. Recorded close and upper/lower focus moves; automatic whole return precedes batches. Title assigned to exported replay afterward; hosted feed retained default An open possibility. No engine changes. Stopped at 88 after deliberate refinement because covers added relief without clarifying form.
creation.exports: Actual browser PNG 900×620 and full replay JSON downloads; actual PNG visually inspected.
